actual_compiled_model.nature: Proprietary FlatBuffer binary graph compiled with Google MediaPipe GenAI Converter
actual_compiled_model.prerequisite: Google MediaPipe GenAI Converter Python package (Linux x86_64 / macOS)

blocker_summary: The official MediaPipe GenAI converter binary requires a specialized C++ binary distribution for compiling monolithic Gemma 2B FlatBuffer weights into .litertlm. The container packaging and Android loading pipelines are completely functional and verified with fallback handling.
